chunks: 4738 - He عليه السلام said regarding the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic:

“As for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overwhelm them with transgression and disbelief. So we intended that their Lord should replace him for them with one better than him in purity and closer in affection.”
He عليه السلام said: “Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, replaced their son with a daughter, and from her were born seventy prophets.”

key_terms.ابْنَةً: a daughter given in place of the son
key_terms.الْغُلَامُ: the boy mentioned in the Qur'anic account

ai.seo_question: What did Allah replace the slain boy with in Surah al-Kahf according to the Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic passage about the boy in Surah al-Kahf by stating that Allah replaced him with a daughter. From that daughter, seventy prophets were born, showing the divine wisdom and blessing in Allah’s decree.
